name: Ray of Ice
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level: sorcerer/wizard 3, winter warlock 3

Components: V, S

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Effect: Ray

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: yes

A ray of frigid air and ice shoots from your pointing finger. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the ray to deal damage to a target. The ray deals 1d6 points of cold damage per caster level (maximum 10d6).
